answer_4.quote: A human-in-the-loop evaluation is performed over the top-K trending claims in which annotators verify whether a claim is misleading and, if so, find the earliest news article debunking the claim.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are required to determine (1) if the extraction is a treatment (2) if the treatment is unapproved and (3) the earliest publication date of a news article they can find that debunks the treatment as effective.
